slots.notes: Center pipeline node: the brand's primary monogram/logomark, single-color fill, sits in a 64px circle as the hub of the icon pipeline (native: Xero pinwheel 'X').
Left pipeline node glyph in a 46px circle; source-stage concept icon (native: layers/stack). Monochrome line/fill SVG.
Right pipeline node glyph in a 46px circle; secured/output-stage concept icon (native: shield with checkmark). Monochrome line/fill SVG.
Social-proof logo strip below the hero card: 5 partner/customer glyphs, ~22px each, muted single-color (geometric/abstract marks paired with wordmark text), flex-wrap row.
Single typeface used across the whole hero (display + body). Native: Inter weights 300/400/500/600/700/800 from Google Fonts; weight 300 powers the thin headline lead-in.

mechanic: A sticky-centered dark glass hero card layers a procedural shaders.js field (sine waves + wave distortion + film grain) under a CSS radial-arc glow and masked 40px grid, while a requestAnimationFrame loop drives a light beam through a 3-node encryption pipeline — pulsing each node active and firing a center splash on a p1 -> splash -> p2 -> idle cycle.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5.4 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 component build, using the `shaders` (shaders/react) package for the GPU background and `lucide-react` for icons; beam animation hand-rolled via refs + requestAnimationFrame and getBoundingClientRect.
reskinNotes:
Heavy reskin friction: the entire background palette (shader SolidColor/SineWave colors #08071a/#0582e8/#f00e94, the multi-stop pink->white radial arc, the purple/pink beam linearGradient, and the splash/node-light tints rgba(255,77,200)/rgba(200,100,255)) is hardcoded in JSX shader props and inline SVG/CSS, NOT in the CSS variables — so the declared --accent/--accent-pink tokens do not actually drive the visible color story. All copy (Xero, Method/Pricing/Docs, headline split across , subtitle with hardcoded
, brand names) is inline in markup, and the thin-300 headline weight plus clamp() sizing make the layout Inter-metric dependent.
